lines: Words had not moved them. So Ibrahim made a plan.
He asked his people: "What are these statues to which you are devoted?" They said: we found our fathers worshipping them.
He said: you and your fathers have been in clear error. And he swore: by Allah, I will plan against your idols after you turn your backs.
On a festival day, the whole town left. The temple stood empty. And Ibrahim went in alone.
He broke the idols into pieces, all of them... except the biggest one.
When the people returned, they cried: who has done this to our gods? Some said: we heard a young man speak of them. His name is Ibrahim.
They brought him before everyone and asked: did you do this to our gods, O Ibrahim?
He said: "Rather, this one, the biggest of them, did it. So ask them, if they can speak."
For a moment, they looked at each other, and knew. Then they lowered their heads and said: you know very well that these do not speak.
And he said: then do you worship, instead of Allah, what can neither benefit you nor harm you? Shame on you, and on what you worship. Will you not use reason?
